economic_control_point: Regulated rate base, category recovery, large-load tariff, or named generation project
payer_or_funding_source: Customer bills, approved recovery, large-load contracts, debt, equity, and NCI
main_burden_carrier: Customers, ratepayers, construction and fuel systems, debt holders, and common owners
owner_cash_question: What cash is billed and collected after paid capex, regulatory timing, financing, taxes, shared ownership, and dilution?
valuation_object: Project or category recovery converted to common-owner return
decisive_promotion_or_breaker: Named category or project closes approved cost to billing determinant to paid capex to billed revenue to collection

economic_control_point: Interconnection density, powered capacity, development pipeline, and lease commencement

main_burden_carrier: Power and construction systems, project lenders, partners, preferred and OP-unit holders, and common owners
owner_cash_question: Does stabilized project cash cover power, recurring capex, lease-up, project debt, partner claims, and dilution?

decisive_promotion_or_breaker: Project capital, commencement, stabilized yield, partner funding, and common residual are joined

economic_control_point: Physical execution, electrical distribution, replenishment, or rental fleet access

main_burden_carrier: Labor and material suppliers, inventory and receivables, fleet funding, project-cost risk, debt, and common owners

valuation_object: Business-specific normalized owner cash; fleet lifecycle return for URI
current_grade: Qualified; QoE and denominator gates open
decisive_promotion_or_breaker: Contract collections, organic backlog, working-capital persistence, replacement capex, and funding claims reconcile

economic_control_point: Clinical installed base, procedure workflow, consumables, service, or procurement interface

main_burden_carrier: Clinical customers, inventory and receivables, integration and recall costs, debt, SBC, and common owners
owner_cash_question: Do utilization, collections, integration cash, maintenance capital, claims, and dilution support distributable cash?

decisive_promotion_or_breaker: Systems join to procedures or collections, and acquisition, claim, lease, SBC, and dilution burdens reconcile

economic_control_point: Procurement route, drug distribution, specialty channel, and practice workflow

economic_control_point: Asset selection, insurance spread, legal-entity transfer, and named borrower or instrument

main_burden_carrier: Policyholders, regulated entities, borrowers, reinsurance and funds-held claims, NCI and preferred holders, and parent balance sheet
owner_cash_question: Which legal entity receives asset cash, pays liability and funding cost, and remits an unrestricted common residual?
valuation_object: Liability-adjusted named-asset return plus platform fee and spread economics
current_grade: Qualified; receipt, liability-cost, and owner-allocation gates open
decisive_promotion_or_breaker: Named asset closes legal entity to instrument to funded principal to receipt to liability cost to parent residual

economic_control_point: Collateral-eligible fleet, powered capacity, development, and project access

owner_cash_question: Can lifecycle or project cash survive borrowing-base haircuts, utilization or lease-up delay, funding cost, and replacement needs?

decisive_promotion_or_breaker: Certificate-grade collateral, lifecycle cash, project commencement, funding, and common residual reconcile

economic_control_point: Reserves, acreage, advantaged production, refining, chemicals, trading, and logistics
